project.name: Thread & Needle
project.description: An online shop for a small yarn and fabric store with inventory management, cart, checkout, and delivered product reviews.

looks.reason: Flat grids and clean content-first structure supporting high typography legibility for craft specifications.
Boutique and tactile craft shop aesthetic with high-contrast rules and spacious imagery.

requested.words: crisp, minimal and Scandinavian; white space, soft grey and a single moss green accent

design.reason: Shoppers browse yarn and fabric with photos and specifications, while shop owners track inventory and fulfill orders.

tours.name: Purchase Products
tours.outcome: Shopper pays for selected items and an order is placed

steps.title: Browses products and selects yarn or fabric items. Rule: Item must be displayed with photo, colour, weight/width, price, and stock count
Adds product to cart with chosen quantity (the cart becomes active). Rule: Quantity must be at least 1
Reviews cart and adjusts quantities if needed (the cart becomes active). Rule: Cart reflects updated item quantities and totals
Submits checkout and completes payment (the order becomes paid). Rule: Payment must succeed and product stock decreases by purchased quantity

tours.name: Fulfill Order
tours.outcome: Order items are dispatched and delivered to the shopper

steps.title: Views paid customer orders (the order becomes paid). Rule: Only paid orders ready for shipment are listed
Marks order as shipped (the order becomes shipped). Rule: Order must be in paid status
Marks order as delivered (the order becomes delivered). Rule: Order must be in shipped status

tours.name: Manage Catalog and Inventory
tours.outcome: Catalog items and stock counts are accurate and available for shoppers

steps.title: Creates or edits product with details, price, and stock level (the product becomes available). Rule: Product must include photo, colour, weight or width, price, and stock count

tours.name: Review Product
tours.outcome: A customer review is published on the product

steps.title: Views delivered orders and item history (the order becomes delivered). Rule: Order status must be delivered
Submits review for the delivered product (the review becomes published). Rule: Can only review products from delivered orders
